theater: 米蘭、倫巴第與威尼托戰線

battle.name: 第一次意大利獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 米蘭、倫巴第與威尼托戰線
battle.brief: 一八四八年三月廿三日米蘭起義揭開「米蘭五日」，奧地利守軍退守倫巴第要塞；四月薩丁出兵迎戰，五月廿九日庫爾塔托內一役學生志願隊被拉德茨基擊潰，八月薩爾拉斯科停戰割讓倫巴第。翌年法國介入、羅馬共和國覆滅，威尼斯在圍攻中投降，戰爭以奧地利收復米蘭與羅馬告終。兩軍骨幹槍械皆雷管步槍。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的一方是奧地利帝國及其在義大利的軍政機構：皇帝弗朗茨·約瑟夫派駐米蘭的帝國軍由拉德茨基老將統率，下轄由波希米亞、匈牙利、加利西亞、克羅地亞與倫巴第本地徵召兵組成的混合部隊，另有由匈牙利總督耶拉契奇率領的南方援助軍，以及從維也納運來的援軍與重砲。另一方是撒丁王國與義大利各地的武裝：撒丁王卡洛·阿爾貝托以「倫巴第王國」為號召出兵，軍隊由老將佩佩整編，配屬由米蘭與威尼斯來的義大利志願軍、米蘭的市民民兵，以及托斯卡納、羅馬、那不勒斯派出的援軍；威尼斯由丹尼埃萊·馬寧領導的共和政府自守，羅馬則在一八四九年二月由馬志尼、卡洛·阿爾梅利尼與朱塞佩·阿韋扎納組成執政三人團，成立羅馬共和國。奧地利與那不勒斯國王斐迪南二世聯合出兵對付羅馬共和國，法國在拿破崙三世授意下由烏迪諾率領遠征軍攻羅馬。第三方之中，英國居中調停，促成八月的停戰線；普魯士則暗中資助撒丁與義大利志願軍，並在維也納對奧地利施加外交壓力。
countriesEn: One side was the Austrian Empire and its military and civil administration in Italy. The imperial army in Milan was commanded by the old Radetzky and was made up of mixed brigades recruited in Bohemia, Hungary, Galicia, Croatia and Lombardy itself, with an auxiliary corps in the south under the Hungarian ban Jellacic, and with reinforcements and heavy guns brought down from Vienna. The other side was the Kingdom of Sardinia and the armed bands of the Italian cities: King Charles Albert marched out under the cry of a Kingdom of Lombardy, his army reorganised by the veteran Guglielmo Pepe and reinforced by the Italian volunteers from Milan and Venice, by the civic militia of Milan, and by contingents sent from Tuscany, Rome and Naples. Venice defended itself under the republican government of Daniele Manin, and in February 1849 Rome appointed a triumvirate of Mazzini, Carlo Armellini and Giuseppe Avezzana, proclaiming the Roman Republic. Austria and Ferdinand II of the Two Sicilies acted together against that republic, and in France Napoleon III sent an expedition under Oudinot against Rome. Among the third parties Britain stood in the middle and helped broker the armistice of August, while Prussia secretly subsidised Sardinia and the Italian volunteers and pressed Austria diplomatically at Vienna.
people: 拉德茨基是這場戰爭的樞紐。他是拿破崙戰爭時代的老將，在米蘭的指揮部裡既要應付米蘭的騷動，又要面對從維也納趕來的召回令，最後選擇把軍隊撤回倫巴第的要塞區，把米蘭讓出來。他手下的總參謀長科羅尼尼-克龍貝格是最早主張以優勢兵力在野外解決義大利人的將領。拉德茨基在波才諾與帕斯特倫哥兩戰中用兩翼進攻的樣板把薩丁先鋒打崩，士氣與補給的差距在這裡被固定下來。撒丁方面，國王卡洛·阿爾貝托以「為義大利而戰」的口號吸引大量志願者，古列爾莫·佩佩整編軍隊並主持兵員補充，作戰仍受制於補給與彈藥不足；停戰線的談判由卡內羅代表薩丁簽訂。米蘭方面，臨時政府由佩爾·馬龍切利主持，明蓋蒂等人掌握市政與輿論。羅馬共和國方面，馬志尼是精神領袖，阿爾梅利尼主持行政，阿韋扎納著手組軍，加里波第以自己的旅駐守城外，在帕萊斯特羅一役以少數兵力擊退法軍而名聲大噪；法軍與那不勒斯「聖費德黨」的部隊聯手攻入羅馬，共和國在七月四日投降。加里波第隨後流亡，馬志尼則在流亡中籌劃新的共和嘗試，兩人的道路直到十年後的西西里登陸才重新合流。
peopleEn: Radetzky was the pivot of the whole war. A veteran of the Napoleonic wars, he had to manage the agitation in Milan and the recall from Vienna at the same time, and he chose to pull the army back into the fortresses of Lombardy and leave Milan. His chief of staff, Count Coronini-Cronberg, was among the first to argue that the Italians should be beaten in the open by superior force. Radetzky broke the Sardinian advance with his two-flank pattern at Goito and Pastrengo, and the gap in morale and supply was fixed there. On the Sardinian side King Charles Albert drew large numbers of volunteers under the cry of a war for Italy, while the veteran Guglielmo Pepe reorganised the army and handled recruitment, though operations remained limited by supply and ammunition; the armistice was signed for Sardinia by Canero. In Milan the provisional government was presided over by Pier Maroncelli, with Minghetti and others holding the municipal and press work. In the Roman Republic Mazzini was the moral leader, Armellini ran the administration, Avezzana organised the army, and Garibaldi, commanding his own brigade outside the walls, made his name at Palestro by throwing back a French force far larger than his own. The French and the Neapolitan Sanfedisti entered Rome together, and the republic capitulated on the fourth of July. Garibaldi went into exile, Mazzini schemed new republican ventures from abroad, and the paths of the two men would not cross again until the landing in Sicily ten years later.
kits: 奧地利步兵的主要槍械是一八四一年制式的韋恩德爾步槍，雷管擊發，紙殼彈加刺刀，另有大量舊式燧發槍與獵槍由各營自行改裝；騎兵配雷管與燧發手槍，砲兵使用六磅與十二磅砲，城市攻堅時還有二十四磅攻城砲。撒丁軍隊的核心是一八四二年制式的卡爾卡諾步槍，同樣是雷管擊發，射程與精度都勝過當年的火槍，是本卡所指的雷管步槍在意大利戰場上的代表；卡爾卡諾槍的缺點是初速不足，遠射時彈道低垂，射手常要瞄到比直射更遠的位置。義大利志願軍與米蘭民兵手上則極雜亂：大量獵槍、私人購置的火槍與零星雷管槍，彈藥直徑不一，紙殼彈稀缺，許多射手一天只有數發。威尼斯守軍使用舊式火槍與艦載砲，羅馬共和軍的武器主要來自前教皇國的庫存與民間徵集，同樣以火槍為主。冷兵器在此役中並未消失：農具、木矛與獵刀在街壘與山地的短兵相接中仍常出現。馬匹的差異更直接影響戰局：奧地利軍的馬匹與車輛由維也納與倫巴第的徵收供應，義大利志願軍的騎兵不足數百匹，許多志願者以步行作戰，行軍與補給因此成為最脆弱的一環。
kitsEn: The main firearm of the Austrian infantry was the Model 1841 Werndl musket, of percussion ignition, fired with a paper cartridge and fitted with a bayonet, and a great many older flintlock muskets and sporting guns were converted by the regiments themselves. The cavalry carried percussion and flint pistols; the artillery used six- and twelve-pounders, with twenty-four-pound siege pieces for the assault on cities. The core of the Sardinian army was the Model 1842 Carcano musket, also a percussion weapon, whose range and accuracy were better than the flintlocks it replaced; this was the percussion rifle of this card in its Italian form. Its weakness was a low muzzle velocity, so at long range the trajectory drooped and the shooter had to aim beyond the target. The equipment of the Italian volunteers and the Milanese militia was a mess: sporting guns, privately bought muskets and a sprinkling of percussion rifles, calibres all differing, paper cartridges scarce, many men firing only a handful of rounds a day. The Venetians used old muskets and naval guns, and the Roman republican forces drew theirs mainly from the former Papal State's stores and from private surrender, flintlocks again predominating. Cold weapons had not vanished: farm tools, wooden pikes and hunting knives still appeared in the close fighting of barricades and hillsides. The difference in horses mattered even more. The Austrian remounts and wagons came from Vienna and from requisitions in Lombardy; the Italian volunteers had fewer than a few hundred mounted men, and many fought on foot, which made marching and supply the most fragile part of their operation.
tactics: 米蘭五日的街壘戰與鄉間的會戰同時展開。起義者依賴狹窄街道與樓房窗口，把石堆與翻覆的馬車築成街壘，射手居高射擊，奧地利步兵在長街中只能以連縱隊前進，每前進一步都付出慘重代價；米蘭城門與城堡的爭奪決定了誰能控制城內。鄉間的會戰則是拿破崙式樣板：薩丁軍以縱隊行軍，砲兵在中央展開，步兵與民兵在兩翼展開；奧地利軍善用村落、堤壩與樹籬作掩體，砲火準備時間長但落點集中，庫爾塔托內一役正是靠村落防禦與砲火射擊，把占據有利地形的學生志願隊壓垮。維克托·埃馬努埃萊二世率騎兵在諾瓦拉反擊帝國軍的側翼，成為義大利騎兵的經典時刻。羅馬保衛戰則把街壘經驗搬到城牆上：加里波第在城外列陣迎擊法軍，利用起伏地形與樹林遮蔽射擊視線；法軍改採迂迴與砲火突擊，最終在城牆缺口突破。防守方在城內築起街壘逐段抵抗，但缺少外援與彈藥的城市終究被攻破。
tacticsEn: The street fighting of the Five Days and the battles of the open country ran side by side. The insurgents relied on narrow streets and the windows of the houses, piling stone and overturned carts into barricades and shooting from above, so that Austrian infantry advancing in single file along the long streets paid dearly for every step; the struggle for the city gates and the castle decided who would hold Milan. In the countryside the battle followed the Napoleonic pattern: the Sardinian army marched in columns with the artillery deployed in the centre and infantry and militia extended on the wings. The Austrians used villages, dykes and hedgerows as cover, their guns needed long preparation but their fire was concentrated, and it was the defence of a village plus massed artillery that crushed the student volunteers at Curtatone and Montanara, although they held favourable ground. Victor Emmanuel II counter-attacked the flank of the imperial army with cavalry at Novara, one of the classic moments of Italian cavalry. The defence of Rome carried the lessons of the barricade out to the city walls: Garibaldi drew his line up outside the city to meet the French, using broken ground and woods to break the enemy's line of sight, and the French answered with turning movements and sudden bombardment until they forced a breach in the walls. The defenders raised barricades in the streets and gave ground street by street, but a city cut off from help and from ammunition was broken in the end.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下。米蘭起義最初的武裝群眾在數萬量級，五日之戰雙方陣亡數以百計，受傷者數倍於此，各方記載的總數從數百到上千都有出入。薩丁王國在一八四八年春出動的正規軍約八萬人，義大利各地志願軍另有好幾萬，多數未受過完整訓練。拉德茨基在戰役初期可用兵力約七萬至八萬，加上五月從維也納開到的援兵與南方援助軍，戰役最盛時帝國軍超過十萬。庫爾塔托內一役，帝國軍出動約一萬人，義軍與志願隊約六千至八千，義方損失數百人，帝國軍的損失則以百計。帕萊斯特羅一役，法軍出動約一萬二千人，羅馬共和軍的中央部隊不足五千。一八四九年六月，法軍集結兵力約一萬二千人、攻城砲數十門，圍城近三個月，七月三日入城，七月四日共和國議會投降。威尼斯的圍城自一八四八年五月延至次年八月，奧地利軍圍城兵力逾一萬，最終迫使威尼斯議會投降。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are roughly as follows. The armed crowds that rose in Milan were in the tens of thousands; in the Five Days the dead on both sides ran to hundreds, the wounded to several times that, and the totals given by different accounts range from several hundred to a thousand. The regular army that Sardinia put into the field in the spring of 1848 was about eighty thousand men, and the volunteers from the Italian cities added tens of thousands more, most of them without proper training. Radetzky had perhaps seventy to eighty thousand men available at the start, and with the reinforcements that came down from Vienna in May and the auxiliary corps from the south the imperial army passed a hundred thousand at the height of the campaign. At Curtatone and Montanara the imperial force engaged was about ten thousand men against six to eight thousand Italians and volunteers; the Italian losses were in the hundreds and the Austrian losses in the hundreds. At Palestro the French had about twelve thousand men against fewer than five thousand in the centre of the Roman republican line. In June 1849 the French assembled some twelve thousand men and several dozen siege guns, besieged Rome for nearly three months, entered the city on the third of July, and on the fourth the republican assembly capitulated. The siege of Venice ran from May 1848 to August 1849, with more than ten thousand Austrian troops in the investing force, and it ended with the surrender of the Venetian assembly.
cause: 一八四八年的意大利要求獨立並不是單一運動，而是幾條線索交疊的結果。統治北意大利的奧地利並非本國民族，倫巴第與威尼托的稅制、司法與教育長期由維也納與米蘭的機構主導，資產階級與知識界對此不滿已數十年；拿破崙時代法國在意大利北部留下的行政與法律遺產，反而成為後來統一運動的藍圖。卡洛·阿爾貝托在米蘭民眾面前暗示可以給北意大利一個王國的頭銜，於是群眾的騷動有了可以依附的目標。宗教與政治同樣重要：意大利中部仍由教廷與奧地利直接支配，問題不解決，北方單獨建國也難以長久。外部的革命浪潮提供了時機：巴黎二月革命推翻七月王朝，維也納的三月革命迫使奧地利從義大利抽走兵力，拉馬丁的臨時政府又明確表示法國支持民族自決，這讓義大利的起義者相信外國不會袖手。秘密社團與報刊的作用不可忽視，「米蘭五天」之所以能夠在數日內擴散，靠的是已經成形的社團網絡與受難者家屬的動員。
causeEn: Italian independence in 1848 was not a single movement but the crossing of several lines of cause. Austria was not a native power in northern Italy, and taxation, justice and education in Lombardy and Venetia had long been run from Vienna and Milan, to the resentment of the propertied classes and the intellectuals for decades. The administrative and legal legacy left by Napoleonic France in northern Italy became, paradoxically, the blueprint for the unification movement that followed. Charles Albert hinted to the crowds of Milan that a kingship in northern Italy was possible, and the agitation acquired a target to attach itself to. Religion and politics mattered as much: the middle of Italy was still ruled directly by the papacy and by Austria, and without a solution there no northern state could last. The revolutionary wave outside supplied the moment. The February revolution in Paris overthrew the July monarchy, the March revolution in Vienna forced Austria to draw troops away from Italy, and the provisional government under Lamartine openly backed national self-determination, which convinced the Italian insurgents that no power would stand aside. The role of the secret societies and the press was not secondary: the Five Days spread across the city in a matter of days because the networks already existed and because the families of the victims could be mobilised.
impact: 這場戰爭的軍事結果是失敗的，政治結果卻是長久的。義大利的民族運動第一次以大規模正規軍、志願兵與民兵的混合形式出現，證明北意大利能徵召十萬人作戰，而軍隊的失敗主要在於補給、彈藥與指揮，而不在士氣。加里波第在羅馬的旅、薩丁志願軍的編制、米蘭民兵的街壘技術，都成為後來一八五九年的倫巴第戰爭與一八六〇年西西里遠征的人事與經驗來源；一八四九年三月諾瓦拉的失敗說明薩丁與帝國軍的實力差距，最後一次靠王朝的角力才保住王位，也就推動了加里波第主張的「人民軍」路線。教廷的流亡、威尼斯與米蘭的統治被取消，使「義大利問題」從此成為歐洲外交的常設議題，一八五九年的法國介入與一八六六年的普奧戰爭都以此為藉口；也正因如此，拿破崙三世的支持裡既有民族主義色彩，也有戰略考量，義大利統一最終是由外力推動，而不是完全由本地力量完成。
impactEn: The military result of this war was a failure and the political result was durable. The Italian national movement appeared for the first time in a mixed form of large regular armies, volunteers and civic militia, and it was shown that northern Italy could raise a hundred thousand men; the defeats were owed to supply, ammunition and command rather than to morale. Garibaldi's brigade in Rome, the organisation of the Sardinian volunteers and the barricade techniques of the Milanese militia all supplied the personnel and the experience for the war of 1859 in Lombardy and the expedition to Sicily in 1860. The defeat at Novara in March 1849 measured the gap between Sardinia and the imperial army, and the throne was saved only by the intervention of another power, which pushed the line Garibaldi argued for, an army of the people. The flight of the pope and the cancellation of Austrian rule in Venice and Milan turned the Italian question into a standing item of European diplomacy, invoked in the French intervention of 1859 and in the Prussian and Austrian war of 1866. Napoleon's support, then, carried both a nationalist colouring and a strategic purpose, and the unification of Italy was in the end pushed forward by outside force rather than completed by local strength alone.
result: 米蘭與倫巴第最終回到奧地利手中，薩丁以停戰線換回和平，代價是放棄倫巴第、威尼斯與倫巴第的國民軍；維克托·埃馬努埃萊二世在諾瓦拉一役擊退帝國軍，卻未能追擊，隨即在與拉馬丁、尼斯的巴黎會議上議定恢復奧地利宗主權，國王的退位是這場戰爭留下的最大政治創傷。威尼斯在長達十五個月的圍城後於一八四九年八月投降，馬寧等領袖被押往維也納。羅馬共和國在法軍與那不勒斯「聖費德黨」部隊的聯合攻擊下崩潰，議會在七月四日簽署投降，法軍進入羅馬，共和派或被殺或流亡。一八四九年之後，北意大利的奧地利統治反而更加牢固，激進派在海外流亡，共和主義與君主主義的分歧加深；但一八五〇年代的三次戰爭改變了一切：第一場把倫巴第交給撒丁，第二場加上威尼斯，第三場把羅馬與教廷一起納入，統一王國在一八六一年成立，那不勒斯於一八六〇年歸入，威尼斯於一八六六年加入，羅馬於一八七〇年歸入。
resultEn: Milan and Lombardy went back to Austria, and Sardinia bought peace with the armistice at the cost of renouncing Lombardy, Venetia and the national army of Lombardy. Victor Emmanuel II threw back the imperial army at Novara but did not follow up, and at the Paris conference with Lamartine and Nice it was agreed to restore Austrian sovereignty; the king's abdication was the deepest political wound left by the war. Venice surrendered in August 1849 after a siege of fifteen months, and Manin and the other leaders were taken to Vienna. The Roman Republic collapsed under the joint attack of the French and the Neapolitan Sanfedisti, the assembly signed the surrender on the fourth of July, French troops entered the city, and the republicans were killed or scattered into exile. Austrian rule in northern Italy became firmer after 1849, the radicals dispersed abroad, and the quarrel between republican and monarchist grew sharper. The three wars of the 1850s changed all of it: the first gave Lombardy to Sardinia, the second added Venice, and the third brought Rome and the papacy as well. The united kingdom was proclaimed in 1861, Naples came in 1860, Venice in 1866 and Rome in 1870.
